summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 13, 2026 news release reporting exploration drill results at the Southern Arc and Kassasoko deposits of the Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal, plus the start of drilling at Kabewest on the recently acquired contiguous Bambadji properties. Highlights include 7.8 g/t gold over 12.8 meters and 3.9 g/t over 40.8 meters true width. A US$8 million drilling campaign with six rigs runs through 2026. No transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is stated; this is routine operational disclosure, not a special situation.
